test_title: PYST 38: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 17 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Select the option that arranges the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.

A) to his neighbours

B) first name is Adam

C) that no one even

D) he is so rude

E) knows that his
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

• The correct order of the sentence parts starts with "D) he is so rude" as it introduces the subject of the sentence.

• Following "D", "A) to his neighbours" logically continues the sentence, indicating to whom the subject's rudeness is directed.

• Next, "C) that no one even" adds further information about the extent of the subject's rudeness.

• The sequence is logically continued with "E) knows that his", which connects the preceding information to the final detail about the subject.

• Finally, "B) first name is Adam" completes the sentence, revealing the specific detail that was unknown due to the subject's rudeness.

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

Correct sentence: *"He is so rude to his neighbours that no one even knows that his first name is Adam."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• Option 2 ("B, D, A, C, E") incorrectly starts with the subject's name, which does not logically introduce the context of rudeness or the reaction of the neighbours.

• Option 3 ("A, C, B, D, E") creates a disjointed sentence that does not logically flow or make coherent sense.

• Option 4 ("C, E, B, A, D") also fails to create a coherent sentence, starting in the middle of the thought process rather than introducing the subject and his behavior.
